entry.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
entry.note: The entry credential in the NVIDIA program for generative AI and large language models
entry.audience: Developers and practitioners working with large language models

covers: How self-supervision improves the transformer architecture in BERT, Megatron, and other LLM variants
Using pretrained modern LLM models for text classification, named-entity recognition, and question answering
Applying iterative prompt engineering best practices to create LLM-based applications
Foundational concepts for developing, integrating, and maintaining AI-driven applications with generative AI and LLMs
reading.format: The exam is online and proctored remotely. It includes 50 questions and has a 60-minute time limit.
reading.summary: This is an entry-level credential that validates foundational concepts for developing, integrating, and maintaining AI-driven applications using generative AI and large language models with NVIDIA solutions. Holding it shows understanding of these foundational concepts.
reading.audience: Professionals looking to enhance their skills and knowledge in AI and related fields.
